name: FrontierAgent
description: Runs an open-source agent runtime and terminal TUI with ReAct and coordinator-plus-subagent team modes, installable in one command on macOS and Linux.

skills.name: ReAct Mode
skills.description: Runs a single agent through interleaved reasoning and tool-calling steps against a task in the terminal.

skills.name: Agent Team Mode
skills.description: Splits work across a coordinator and parallel subagents, merging their results back into one task outcome.

skills.name: Terminal TUI
skills.description: Presents agent runs, tool calls, and intermediate state in an interactive terminal interface for live inspection.
